title: Save Display Settings | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our UI in CLO 2025.0 allows you to save custom display settings with the project file, maintaining the same setup. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio
